task_spec.prompt: Go to the page at input/target-url.txt. Find the three most recent article titles listed on that page and save them, one per line and in top-to-bottom order, to a plain text file named titles.txt.
core_assertions: primary: titles.txt contains exactly the three most-recent article titles
primary: the titles are in the correct top-to-bottom order
no destructive side-effects: nothing on the page was submitted or changed
task_spec.setup: 目标网址见 input/target-url.txt。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 用其中给定的 URL,勿自换网页。

dirty_data.note: Clean browser-web pilot: a static list page, unambiguous 'three most recent'. Ads / infinite scroll / mixed-order feeds belong to a later stress-tier task.

files.input: input/target-url.txt — the page URL handed to the product
files.expected: expected/end-state.md — titles.txt holds the 3 latest titles in order
